predecessors.name: Harikela Kingdom
predecessors.text: Harikela, which the Chandras ruled 'during the 10th century CE' (Harikela page)

successors.name: Pala Empire
successors.text: the Chandra kingdom annexed by the Palas of Varendra

successors.name: Varman dynasty of east Bengal
successors.text: Vanga, overthrown by the Varmans according to the Harikela page

ledger.x: 900: Trailokyachandra begins the Chandra line of Harikela.

c. 930 (bridge): Srichandra makes Bikrampur in Vanga the centre of the kingdom. 'administrative centre of the Chandra kingdom was established in Bikrampur in Vanga'; reign c. 930-975 (one place says c. 925-975). The page gives no year for the move and does not say who held Vanga; the pala-empire dossier (another…

c. 930 (bridge): the Srihatta-mandala in Srichandra's reign. 'Under Srichandra, the Srihatta-mandala covered greater Sylhet and southern Assam plains', and he 'led invasions into Kamarupa'. No year for Sylhet; the reign start is used. Page silent on the year and on who held Sylhet before.

wars.name: Srichandra's invasions of Kamarupa
wars.outcome: The page says only that Srichandra 'led invasions into Kamarupa'; no land is recorded as taken or lost.

wars.name: Chola Ganges expedition
wars.outcome: Rajendra Chola's army 'defeated Govindachandra of the Chandra dynasty' (Rajendra Chola I page); 'The Chola Indian Mainland expedition ended in 1022'.

wars.name: Pala annexation of the Chandra kingdom
wars.outcome: The Chandras were 'eventually annexed by the Pala dynasty of Varendra under Govindachandra (reign 1020-1050)'; page silent on any campaign, date or battle.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line on the pages; the realm is described by names (Samatata, Harikela, Vanga, Srihatta-mandala, 'parts of Arakan').
